# Feishu official streaming bundle

`official-stream.js` bundles the official Lark/Feishu card controller ported from
[larksuite/openclaw-lark](https://github.com/larksuite/openclaw-lark) (2026.7.9, commit
`dde0be3680d6fd5443cab426c8f4b3216266346a`, MIT). It drives CardKit streaming cards with
quote-bound replies, staged edit windows, and connection-level message dedup.

See `LICENSE.openclaw-lark`, `NOTICE.openclaw-lark`, and `UPSTREAM_COMMIT` in this directory.
